module_title: The National Giants: RBI, ISRO, DRDO, and SEBI
introduction: At this level, we cover the four most prominent organizations in India. Their headquarters, foundation years, and core mandates are absolute 'evergreen' questions across all competitive exams.

core_concepts.title: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Mumbai, Maharashtra**. 
Established: **1st April 1935** (Nationalized on 1st Jan 1949). 
Key Fact: It was established on the recommendation of the **Hilton Young Commission**. It is India's central bank and regulates the monetary policy.

core_concepts.title: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Bengaluru, Karnataka**. 
Established: **15th August 1969**. 
Key Fact: Founded by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai (the father of the Indian space program). It is responsible for India's space exploration and satellite programs.

core_concepts.title: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New Delhi** (DRDO Bhavan). 
Established: **1958**. 
Key Fact: It operates under the Ministry of Defence and is responsible for the military's research and development, including advanced missile systems (like Agni and Prithvi).

core_concepts.title: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Mumbai, Maharashtra**. 
Established: 1988 (Given Statutory Status in **1992**). 
Key Fact: It is the apex regulatory body for the securities and commodity market in India (Stock Market and Mutual Funds).

important_entities.name: NITI Aayog
important_entities.significance: Headquarters: New York. Established: **1st January 2015**. NITI stands for 'National Institution for Transforming India'. The Prime Minister of India serves as its ex-officio Chairperson.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Exam Trap: Students frequently mix up the locations of India's space and defense hubs. 
- Space (ISRO) is in the southern tech hub: **Bengaluru**. 
- Defense (DRDO) is in the national capital: **New Delhi**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Money and Markets live in Mumbai
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The RBI (Bankers' Bank), SEBI (Stock Market Boss), SBI (Largest Bank), and LIC (Insurance Giant) all deal with massive finance, and all have their headquarters in **Mumbai**.

exam_strategy_tips: A guaranteed question in SSC and Banking exams: 'The Reserve Bank of India was set up on the basis of the recommendations of which commission?' Answer: Hilton Young Commission.
